dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: What's wrong with it? You mean, breaking Inazuman regulations?

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: I think it depends on the person. Some people are quite content to spend their whole lives within the fences of their farm...

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: But not me! If there's anything that can fence me in, it's somewhere beyond these lands, beyond the seas, beyond the stars!

dialogues.speaker: Atsuko
dialogues.text: If you can't understand the value of freedom, let me be the one to explain it to you!
